name: Preparation and Colouration of Textiles-II
description: Preparation of synthetic fibres and blends, heat setting. The principles of dyeing of synthetic fibres; classification of dyes used for synthetic fibre dyeing; disperse dyeing of polyester – high-temperature and carrier dyeing methods; cationic dyeing of modified polyester and acrylic fibres; acid and metal complex dyeing of polyamide (nylon) and elastane (spandex); dyeing blended synthetic fibres; dyeing of high-performance fibres; dope dyeing of synthetic fibres; space dyeing. The principles of printing of textile materials; methods of printing namely, roller, screen, transfer, ink jet and the preparation of printing paste; styles of printing - direct, discharge and resist styles of printing; printing of blends. Case studies – industry best practices and innovations; sustainability certifications and regulations.
